paper.title: PReMISE: Policy Rubrics as Measurement Specifications for LLM Judges
paper.abstract: LLM judges are increasingly used to evaluate open-ended responses, but their scores depend strongly on the rubrics that condition them. A vague rubric asking for a response to be ``helpful and factual'' can reward polished answers that invent facts or violate user intent. We treat reusable rubrics as measurement specifications: changing the rubric changes the response quality measurement induced by a fixed judge. We introduce PReMISE, a framework that, given pairwise human-preference data, (i) d

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的不是“如何让 judge 更强”，而是“同一个 judge 在不同 rubric 条件下到底在测什么，以及这个测量能否被信任”。作者把可复用的 policy-level rubric 视为一种 measurement specification：rubric 一变，固定 judge 所诱导出的评价器就变了。问题在于，很多开放式任务的自动评测、偏好建模、数据过滤，甚至训练信号本身，都建立在这类 rubric-conditioned judge 上，但社区往往只讨论模型能力，不系统检查 rubric 是否结构清楚、是否稳定、是否真的贴合人类偏好、以及是否容易被对抗性利用。论文要解决的核心，就是给这类 rubric-conditioned judge 建立一套可操作的 discover–audit–repair 流程。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接意义，不在于它提出了新的 LM 训练目标，而在于它触及了训练信号质量这个更上游的问题。现在很多 post-train、reward modeling、synthetic preference data、LLM-as-a-judge 过滤流程，都把 rubric 当成自然语言提示词来用，默认它“差不多够用”。这篇工作说明，rubric 不是中性的描述文本，而是决定测量对象的规范；如果 rubric 有缺陷，后续 benchmark、数据筛选、reward、甚至蒸馏目标都会被系统性带偏。对做基座模型的人，这个贡献更像是“评测与训练接口的测量学补课”：它提醒人们，训练信号的失真不只来自模型，也来自 specification 本身。量级上，它更偏方法论和基础设施，不是直接改进模型性能的工作，但对依赖 LLM judge 的训练闭环有实际影响。
summary.technical_approach: 方法分三部分。第一部分是 Discover。输入是成对的人类偏好数据 (p, y+, y-)。作者不直接让模型生成一份总 rubric，而是先对每个偏好对抽取 5 到 15 个“区分优劣的行为维度”，并给两个回答在这些维度上打分。这样会得到数量在 10^3 到 10^4 级别的原始 criteria。随后用 embed–cluster–sub-group–describe 的流程做归并，把冗余、实例特定、表述重叠的 criteria 压缩成可复用 rubric 集。这里的目标不是复述每个 pair 的 rationale，而是找出能跨 prompt 复用、又能解释偏好的行为维度。第二部分是 Audit。作者把 rubric-conditioned judge 的质量拆成四个轴：结构充分性、可靠性、偏好拟合、对抗鲁棒性。结构充分性检查 rubric 是否原子化、是否重叠、是否覆盖关键行为；可靠性看独立 judge 或不同 prompt template 下评分一致性；偏好拟合看 rubric 是否真的提升对人类偏好的预测，而不是只靠 judge 的无 rubric 先验；对抗鲁棒性则看是否能在违背真实意图时仍骗到高分。这个拆分很关键，因为高一致性不等于有效，高偏好拟合也不等于抗攻击。第三部分是 Repair。作者给出两类针对性修复：preference-rank selection，用审计结果筛掉对偏好预测贡献低甚至有害的 criteria；reliability-constrained refinement，在提升鲁棒性的同时约束一致性不要明显恶化。整个框架的重点不是训练一个新 judge，而是把 rubric 当成可编辑对象，围绕 judge induced by rubric 做闭环优化。
summary.experiments: 实验结论比较明确。首先，不同来源的 rubric——无论是原始人工写的、已有规范文本，还是自动发现的——没有任何一种能同时在四个维度都占优。作者特别强调，原始 source rubric 往往在某一项看起来不错，但在 preference fit 或 adversarial robustness 上会明显掉队。其次，PReMISE 发现出来的 rubric 是唯一一类能同时在 per-prompt applicability、对源分布的 specificity、以及 effective dimensionality 上取得非平凡表现的方案，说明它提取到的不是泛泛而谈的评价词，而是更可操作的行为维度。修复实验里，preference-rank selection 把 paired-response judge accuracy 从 65.0% 提升到 68.6%，这个数字是跨三种 judge、两种 prompt template、跨 source 平均得到的。另一个关键结果是 reliability-constrained refinement 把 Verified Fool Rate 从 46.4% 降到 36.0%，代价是 Δα = -0.012，说明鲁棒性提升不是靠大幅牺牲一致性换来的。对这类评测方法论文，最重要的不是单点分数，而是它把“rubric 好坏”拆成了可测、可修、且彼此张力明确的几个维度。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读时先看 Introduction 和 Figure 1、Figure 2，抓住作者的核心立场：rubric 不是提示词装饰，而是 measurement specification。然后重点看 Section 3 的四轴审计定义，尤其是 preference fit 与 adversarial robustness 的 operationalization，这部分决定了整篇工作的可信度。再看 repair 部分，理解 preference-rank selection 和 reliability-constrained refinement 分别在修什么问题。实验部分建议优先看不同 rubric source 的横向比较表，以及修复前后 judge accuracy、Verified Fool Rate 的变化。预计 25 到 35 分钟能把主线读清；如果你关心 LLM judge 用于 reward 或数据过滤，值得再细看 appendix 里 criteria mining 和 audit prompt 的实现细节。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper is not mainly about making the judge model stronger. It asks a more upstream question: for a fixed LLM judge, what exactly changes when the rubric changes, and can the resulting measurement be trusted? The authors treat reusable policy-level rubrics as measurement specifications. Once the rubric changes, the induced evaluator changes as well, even if the underlying judge model is identical. This matters because open-ended evaluation, preference modeling, data filtering, and even some training pipelines increasingly rely on rubric-conditioned judges, yet rubric quality is rarely audited in a systematic way. The core problem is therefore to build an operational discover-audit-repair pipeline for rubric-conditioned evaluation.
summary_en.importance: Its relevance to pretraining is indirect but real. The paper does not propose a new pretraining objective. Instead, it targets the quality of supervision sources that increasingly feed into post-training, reward modeling, synthetic preference generation, and LLM-as-a-judge filtering. The main contribution is a measurement perspective: rubrics are not harmless natural-language instructions, but specifications that define what the evaluator is measuring. If the rubric is flawed, the downstream benchmark, reward signal, filtered corpus, or distilled target can all become systematically biased. For foundation-model researchers, this is useful because it sharpens the interface between evaluation and training. The impact is methodological rather than headline model gains, but it is important anywhere judge-based supervision is part of the training loop.
summary_en.technical_approach: The framework has three stages. First is Discover. Starting from pairwise human preference data (prompt, preferred response, dispreferred response), the system does not directly ask for a final rubric. Instead, for each pair it extracts 5 to 15 salient behavioral criteria that distinguish the two responses, and scores both responses on those criteria. This produces a large pool of raw candidate criteria, on the order of 10^3 to 10^4. These candidates are then consolidated through an embed-cluster-subgroup-describe pipeline to remove redundancy, reduce instance-specific phrasing, and produce a compact reusable rubric set. The goal is not to reproduce every local rationale, but to recover reusable behavioral dimensions that repeatedly explain human preferences. Second is Audit. The induced rubric-conditioned judge is evaluated along four axes: structural adequacy, reliability, preference fit, and adversarial robustness. Structural adequacy checks whether criteria are atomic, non-overlapping, and behaviorally covering. Reliability measures agreement across judges or prompt templates. Preference fit asks whether the rubric adds predictive value for human preferences beyond a no-rubric prior. Adversarial robustness tests whether high scores can be obtained while violating the intended construct. This decomposition is one of the strongest parts of the paper because it separates agreement from validity and ordinary preference prediction from exploit resistance. Third is Repair. The paper proposes two targeted edits: preference-rank selection, which keeps criteria that materially help preference prediction, and reliability-constrained refinement, which improves robustness while controlling degradation in agreement. The key idea throughout is to optimize the rubric as an editable specification rather than retrain the judge itself.
summary_en.experiments: The main empirical finding is that no rubric source dominates all four audit axes. Handwritten rubrics, published policy-style specifications, and automatically discovered rubrics each have different failure modes. Some look reasonable structurally but do not fit human preferences well; others predict preferences on ordinary examples but remain easy to exploit adversarially. The discovered PReMISE rubrics are reported as the only source that scores non-trivially on per-prompt applicability, source-distribution specificity, and effective dimensionality at the same time, suggesting that the mined criteria are more than generic evaluation buzzwords. In the repair stage, preference-rank selection improves paired-response judge accuracy from 65.0% to 68.6%, averaged across three judges and two prompt templates. Reliability-constrained refinement reduces Verified Fool Rate from 46.4% to 36.0% with only a small reliability tradeoff, reported as Δα = -0.012. For this kind of evaluation paper, the important result is less the absolute number and more the fact that rubric quality becomes measurable, decomposable, and repairable.
summary_en.reading_guide: For a quick read, start with the introduction and the first two figures. They make the central claim clearly: a rubric is a measurement specification, not just a prompt wrapper. Then go to the section defining the four audit axes. Preference fit and adversarial robustness are especially worth reading carefully, because they determine whether the framework is merely descriptive or actually useful. After that, read the repair section to understand what preference-rank selection and reliability-constrained refinement are fixing. In the experiments, prioritize the tables comparing rubric sources and the before-after results for judge accuracy and Verified Fool Rate. A 25 to 35 minute read is enough to get the main ideas. If your work uses LLM judges for reward, filtering, or synthetic supervision, the appendix details on criteria mining and audit prompting are worth a closer look.

recommendation.zh: 对 pretrain 研究员的价值在于：RLHF/对齐中 reward model 的 rubric 设计直接影响训练信号质量，PReMISE 的四维审计框架可直接复用。看 §3 审计方法即可。
recommendation.en: Valuable for pretrain researchers: rubric design for reward models directly impacts training signal quality in RLHF/alignment. PReMISE's four-axis audit framework is reusable—read §3 only.

paper.title: Send a SCOUT First: Pre-hoc Reasoning for Adaptive Detector Allocation in Prompt-Injection Defense
paper.abstract: Prompt-injection detectors are heterogeneous: each is strong on a different slice of attacks, and none is always reliable. Yet existing systems still treat detection as a fixed single-detector pipeline, committing every request to one detector's blind spots. We reframe defense as detector allocation: given a heterogeneous pool, decide per request which detectors to run and whether to escalate to an LLM judge. Our framework SCOUT (Scalable and Controllable Outcome-prediction for Uncertainty-aware

summary.core_problem: 现有 prompt-injection 防御系统将检测视为固定的单检测器或级联管道，每个请求被提交给固定检测器，承受该检测器的盲区。实际上不同检测器在不同攻击类别上各有优劣：基于规则的极快但在复杂攻击上差，LLM judge（如 GPT-4o）最准但慢约 1.5 秒（4 个数量级差距）。论文将防御重新定义为『检测器分配』问题：给定异构检测器池，逐请求决定运行哪些检测器以及是否升级到 LLM judge。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究者的主要启发不在于预训练本身，而在于一种通用的系统设计思路：当存在多个异构组件时，用检索相似样本的历史行为来预测当前输入的最优组件选择。这种无需重新训练的动态分配框架在推理部署、多模型路由、甚至数据选择中都有潜在应用。SCOUT 的训练无关检测器集成（只需在 anchor 集上单遍生成 fingerprint）是简洁的工程设计。
summary.technical_approach: SCOUT 框架核心是检测器 fingerprint 机制：在一组代表性 anchor 输入上单遍记录每个检测器的裁决(attack/benign)、正确性和延迟，形成 fingerprint；然后在推理时，对每个请求用 dense retrieval 检索最相关的 anchors（按注入结构而非主题内容对齐），取 K 个最近邻。基于检索到的 fingerprint 切片，一个小型预测器估计当前输入下每个检测器的可靠性和延迟。路由层并行运行预测可靠的轻检测器，仅当投票不确定时升级到 LLM judge。关键设计：(1) 单阈值 τ 让操作员在安全-延迟之间连续调节；(2) 新增检测器无需重新训练检索器/预测器/路由器。
summary.experiments: 构建了 SCOUT-450 benchmark（450 样本，富含结构复杂的 agent-facing 注入，是旧数据集的补充）。主要结果：相对始终使用 GPT-4o judge 的基线，SCOUT 将攻击成功率(ASR)降低 46%，总 wall-clock 降低 40%，良性效用代价 5.1 个百分点。系统零精调迁移到 BIPIA、IPI、IHEval 三个数据集。在部分攻击类别上，轻检测器表现超过 LLM judge。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读：重点看方法章节（Detector Fingerprints and Retrieval 及后续）、实验主表。对预训练研究者最有启发的是 detector fingerprint 和训练无关集成的设计理念。预计 10-15 分钟。无需细读理论推导。
summary.authors_note: 机构和作者信息从提供的内容中无法确认，需查看原论文。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing prompt-injection defense systems treat detection as a fixed single-detector or cascade pipeline, committing every request to fixed detectors and inheriting their blind spots. In reality, different detectors excel on different attack categories: rule-based methods are extremely fast but poor on complex attacks, while LLM judges (e.g., GPT-4o) are most accurate but slow (~1.5s, 4 orders of magnitude). The paper reframes defense as a detector allocation problem: given a heterogeneous pool, decide per request which detectors to run and whether to escalate to an LLM judge.
summary_en.importance: The primary relevance to pretraining researchers is not in pretraining itself, but in a general system design idea: when multiple heterogeneous components exist, use historical behavior on retrieved similar samples to predict optimal component selection for the current input. This training-free dynamic allocation framework has potential applications in inference deployment, multi-model routing, and even data selection. SCOUT's training-free detector integration (single pass over anchor set for fingerprint) is notable engineering design.
summary_en.technical_approach: The core of SCOUT is a detector fingerprint mechanism: record each detector's verdict (attack/benign), correctness, and latency on a representative set of anchor inputs in a single pass, forming a fingerprint. At inference time, for each request, dense retrieval finds the most relevant anchors, aligned by injection structure (category, hiding strategy, carrier, mechanism) rather than topical content. Based on the retrieved fingerprint slice, a small predictor estimates each detector's reliability and latency on the current input. The router runs predicted-reliable light detectors in parallel and escalates to the LLM judge only when the vote is uncertain. Key design properties: (1) a single threshold τ lets operators continuously tune safety vs. latency; (2) adding new detectors requires no retraining of retriever/predictor/router.
summary_en.experiments: SCOUT-450 benchmark (450 samples, enriched for structurally complex agent-facing injections). Key results: 46% lower attack success rate (ASR) and 40% lower total wall-clock vs. always-on GPT-4o judge, at 5.1-point benign utility cost. Zero-retraining transfer to BIPIA, IPI, and IHEval. Light detectors outperform the LLM judge on some attack categories.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim: focus on method sections (Detector Fingerprints and Retrieval, then routing) and main experimental tables. Most relevant to pretraining researchers is the design philosophy of detector fingerprints and training-free integration. Estimated 10-15 minutes. No need to read theory in depth.

recommendation.zh: 不是 pretrain 论文，但 agent 安全里这个 framing 是对的：别再迷信单一 detector；读 benchmark 设计和 triage 策略，方法细节次之。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but the framing is right for agent safety: stop assuming a single detector is enough; read the benchmark design and triage policy first.

paper.title: LLM Judges Inconsistently Disagree Across Safety Criteria and Harm Categories
paper.abstract: We evaluate the consistency of automated judges in conducting a multi-dimensional safety evaluation in a reference-free setup. Our results indicate that Large Language Models are unreliable judges in identifying safety issues related to machine-generated advice in regulated domains such as finance, although they are more reliable at identifying more overt forms of unsafe/harmful content such as violence. The degree of inconsistency in a model's judgments can vary significantly by the chosen safe

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作研究的是：在没有标准答案可对照的 reference-free 安全评测里，LLM 作为 judge 到底稳不稳，尤其是在“多维安全标准”下是否会对语义等价的内容给出一致判断。作者没有把安全只看成二分类，而是拆成六类判定维度，并同时考察两种一致性：同一个 judge 面对翻译、改写、文化背景替换后的等价文本，是否还能给出相同结论；不同 judge 面对同一输出，是否会彼此达成稳定共识。核心问题不是单次准确率，而是评测信号本身是否可靠，能不能作为训练、对齐或模型比较的依据。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接启发不在“如何训练更强模型”，而在“如何相信评测信号”。如果 judge 在语言、文风、伤害类型、判定标准上都不稳定，那么很多 safety post-train、拒答策略优化、甚至 reward model 或自动数据筛选流程都会建立在高噪声标签上。文章的价值主要有三点。第一，它把安全 judge 的问题从“平均分高不高”推进到“标签是否可重复、可迁移、可聚合”。第二，它指出 raw agreement 容易误导，必须看 chance-corrected agreement，这对任何用 LLM 做自动标注、自动偏好判断、自动过滤的数据管线都有参考意义。第三，它给出一个较完整的多语言、多标准、一致性导向的分析框架，适合被迁移到 alignment、reward 建模和合成数据质检场景。
summary.technical_approach:
方法上，作者构建了一个不依赖 gold label 的一致性评测流程。数据来自 AIRBench-2024 中两类风险：一类是更贴近现实决策风险的 operational misuse，包括 automated decision making 和 regulated advice；另一类是更显性的 violence / extremism / criminal activities 等伤害。作者先取 50 个 opmisuse 种子问题和 39 个 violence 种子问题。对 opmisuse，使用 GPT-4o-Mini 生成 5 个文化/地域变体，只改人名、地点、货币、背景设定，不改变语义；最终得到 300 个查询。对 violence，由于模型常拒绝生成变体，作者改为人工写 1–2 个变体，得到 56 个查询。

随后，作者用同一个生成模型 GPT-4o-Mini 为这些查询生成回答，再对 query-response 对构造两类语义等价变换：翻译到 5 种语言，以及释义/改写。这样可以把 judge 的稳定性和生成模型本身解耦，重点看 judge 是否会被表面形式扰动。评测时使用 6 个主流 LLM 作为 judges，对每个回答按 6 个安全相关标准打分。虽然给出的全文片段没有完整列出六个标准，但从引言可知至少覆盖 helpfulness、warning sufficiency、refusal 等多维属性，而不是单一 unsafe/safe 标签。

分析指标分两层。第一层是 self-consistency：同一 judge 对原文、翻译、改写版本的判断一致程度。第二层是 cross-consistency：不同 judges 对同一内容的判断一致程度。作者特别强调不能只看简单 agreement，因为在类别分布偏斜、某些标准几乎总被判成同一类时，表面一致率会虚高，因此引入 chance-corrected agreement 来校正随机一致性。这个点很关键，因为安全评测里 refusal、warning 这类标签往往天然不均衡，raw agreement 很容易把“大家都默认给同一边”误判成“大家真的理解一致”。
summary.experiments:
实验覆盖约 350 个安全 prompts，分属两类风险，并扩展到 6 种语言。judge 侧评估 6 个广泛使用的先进 LLM。文章的主要发现比较稳定：

1. 对 regulated advice、automated decision making 这类边界更模糊、需要细粒度规范理解的内容，LLM judges 明显不可靠；对 violence 这类更显性的伤害，判断相对稳定。
2. 同一个 judge 在翻译和改写后经常改判，说明 self-consistency 偏低。作者把这解释为一种潜在的 judge jailbreak 面：只要改变语言或文风，不改语义，就可能绕过安全审查。
3. 不同 judges 之间分歧很大，cross-consistency 低，而且这种分歧会随安全标准、风险类别、语言而显著变化。也就是说，LLM-as-a-Jury 并不天然比单 judge 更可靠，很多时候只是把不稳定性平均化，而不是消除它。
4. raw agreement 会高估一致性，chance-corrected 指标能更真实地暴露 judge 的不稳。

从可复用的信息看，最有价值的不是某个单点数字，而是实验设计：同一生成模型、语义等价扰动、多语言、多标准、单 judge 与多 judge 并看，并且控制 prompt 与 reference-free 设定。这种设计比只报一个 overall safety score 更接近真实部署场景。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议是先看 Introduction 和 Figure 2，理解作者为什么把问题定义成 self-consistency 与 cross-consistency，而不是准确率。然后重点看 Methodology 里数据构造流程：种子 query、文化变体、翻译、改写、统一生成模型、六维安全标准。这部分决定了结论是否可信。接着看结果部分里不同 harm category、不同 language、不同 criterion 的分解结果，尤其是 chance-corrected agreement 与 raw agreement 的对比。预计 20–30 分钟可以抓住主线。

如果你关心 pretrain/post-train 接口，建议额外留意作者对 regulated-domain advice 的分析，因为这类内容最接近真实对齐数据中的灰区样本。值得深挖的点有两个：一是哪些安全维度最容易受语言风格影响；二是如果把 judge 输出当作训练标签，噪声会如何沿着数据合成或 reward 建模链路放大。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks a narrow but important question: in reference-free safety evaluation, are LLM judges stable enough to be trusted when safety is defined along multiple criteria rather than a single safe/unsafe label? The authors study two forms of reliability. Self-consistency measures whether the same judge gives the same verdict after semantically invariant transformations such as translation or paraphrase. Cross-consistency measures whether different judges agree on the same model output. The target is not accuracy against gold labels, but the reliability of the evaluation signal itself.
summary_en.importance: Its relevance to pretraining is indirect but real. Many alignment and post-training pipelines rely on automated judges for filtering, preference collection, refusal tuning, or synthetic data curation. If the judge signal is unstable across language, style, harm type, and criterion, then downstream training is built on noisy supervision. The paper contributes in three useful ways. First, it reframes safety evaluation from average score to repeatability and agreement. Second, it shows that raw agreement can be misleading and that chance-corrected agreement is necessary in skewed label settings. Third, it provides a practical evaluation template that can be reused for reward modeling, synthetic data QA, and multilingual alignment audits.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The methodology is a reference-free consistency audit. The data comes from AIRBench-2024 and covers two broad risk families: operational misuse, including automated decision making and advice in regulated industries, and more explicit harm categories such as violence, extremism, self-harm, political misuse, and criminal activities. The authors start from 50 operational-misuse seed queries and 39 violence-related seed queries. For operational misuse, they use GPT-4o-Mini to generate five culturally adapted variants per seed by changing names, places, currencies, and demographic details without changing the underlying semantics, yielding 300 queries in total. For violence, model-generated variants were often refused, so they manually created one to two variants per seed, ending with 56 queries.

All responses are then generated by a single generator model, GPT-4o-Mini, to keep the judged content controlled. On top of that, the authors create semantically equivalent transformations of each query-response pair, including translation into five languages and paraphrasing. This isolates judge robustness from generator variability. Six widely used LLMs are then used as judges, and each output is evaluated along six safety-related criteria. The full excerpt does not list all six criteria, but the paper clearly moves beyond binary harm detection and includes dimensions such as helpfulness, warnings, and refusal behavior.

The analysis has two layers. Self-consistency checks whether one judge remains stable across original, translated, and paraphrased versions. Cross-consistency checks whether multiple judges converge on the same judgment. A key methodological point is the use of chance-corrected agreement rather than raw agreement alone. In safety evaluation, some criteria are naturally imbalanced, so naive agreement can look high even when judges are not meaningfully aligned.
summary_en.experiments:
The study evaluates roughly 350 safety prompts across two risk families and six languages, using six LLM judges. The main empirical pattern is clear. LLM judges are much less reliable on regulated advice and automated decision-making content, where safety depends on nuanced policy interpretation, than on explicit harm such as violence. The same judge often changes its verdict after translation or paraphrase, indicating low self-consistency and suggesting a realistic attack surface for judge jailbreaks through surface-form changes. Different judges also disagree substantially on the same content, with cross-consistency varying by criterion, domain, and language.

Another important result is methodological: raw agreement tends to overstate reliability, while chance-corrected metrics reveal much weaker consistency. The most reusable part of the paper is not a single headline number but the experimental design itself: one fixed generator, semantically invariant perturbations, multilingual evaluation, multi-criterion safety judgments, and separate analysis of within-judge and between-judge stability.
summary_en.reading_guide:
For a quick read, start with the introduction and the workflow figure to understand why the paper focuses on self-consistency and cross-consistency instead of accuracy. Then read the methodology carefully: seed query selection, cultural variants, translations, paraphrases, the fixed generator model, and the six-dimensional judgment setup. After that, go to the result tables that break down agreement by harm category, language, and criterion, especially the comparison between raw and chance-corrected agreement. About 20 to 30 minutes is enough to extract the main message.

If your interest is the pretrain-to-posttrain interface, pay extra attention to the regulated-domain advice setting. That is the closest to the gray-zone data often used in alignment and synthetic supervision pipelines. Two follow-up questions are worth keeping in mind: which safety dimensions are most sensitive to style and language, and how such instability would propagate if judge outputs were used as training labels.

recommendation.zh: 对做对齐/安全的人是“别把judge当标注员”的实证补刀；重点看分歧按准则/语言拆解的结果，顺手检查他们的一致性度量是否严谨。
recommendation.en: A useful empirical reminder that judges aren’t annotators; focus on the breakdown by criteria/language and sanity-check whether their agreement metrics and controls are clean.

paper.title: Inferring Code Correctness from Specification
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have become integral to modern software development, enabling automated code generation at scale. However, validating the correctness of LLM-generated code remains a critical and largely unsolved challenge. Existing approaches either rely on dynamic consensus across multiple code candidates - making them costly and difficult to scale - or on static reasoning that is susceptible to dynamic bugs and order bias. In this paper, we propose TRAILS~ (Targeted Reasoning Agre

summary.core_problem: 在不直接让 LLM 阅读候选代码的情况下，判断 LLM 生成代码是否满足自然语言 specification。
summary.importance: 贡献是代码正确性验证方法，对 coding agent 和自动化程序评估有价值；对基座预训练的间接价值在于提供更可执行的 correctness 信号，可能用于后训练或数据筛选。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 TRAILS：先基于 specification 做 category partitioning 生成多样测试输入，执行候选程序得到 input-output pairs，再让 LLM 判断这些输入输出是否符合 specification，最后跨输入聚合分数估计程序正确性。
summary.experiments: 摘要说明其目标是替代昂贵的多候选动态共识和易受动态 bug/顺序偏置影响的静态推理，但未给出具体数据集、模型、baseline、成本或准确率提升；需要正文确认评估设置。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper estimates whether LLM-generated code satisfies a natural-language specification without asking the LLM to directly reason over the candidate code.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a code-correctness verification method for coding agents and automated program evaluation. Its indirect value for foundation-model work is a more executable correctness signal that could support post-training or data filtering.
summary_en.technical_approach: TRAILS first generates diverse test inputs via category partitioning from the specification, executes the candidate program to obtain input-output pairs, asks an LLM whether those pairs conform to the specification, and aggregates scores across inputs.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract positions the method against costly dynamic consensus and brittle static reasoning, but does not report datasets, base models, baselines, cost, or accuracy gains; the evaluation setup needs to be checked in the full paper.

recommendation.zh: 有用点在“判 IO 而非读代码”的 verifier 设计；若实验覆盖不够，只能当后训练奖励信号的弱候选。
recommendation.en: The useful idea is judging I/O behavior rather than reading code; without broad evaluation, it is only a weak candidate for post-training reward signals.

paper.title: Agents that Matter: Optimizing Multi-Agent LLMs via Removal-Based Attribution
paper.abstract: As multi-agent systems (MAS) become increasingly complex, identifying the contributions of individual agents is critical for system optimization. However, existing approaches lack a rigorous, unified framework for credit assignment. In this work, we formalize agent attribution as a cooperative game, parameterized by the coalition distribution, removal protocol, and target metric. Using this framework, we show that Leave-One-Out (LOO) identifies bottleneck agents as effectively as combinatorial m

summary.core_problem: 论文要解决的是多智能体 LLM 系统里的 credit assignment：当系统表现变好或变差时，如何把贡献或责任归因到具体 agent、角色和交互结构上，而不是只看整体成功率。
summary.importance: 这篇对基座预训练本身不是直接贡献，但对 agent 系统评测和后训练闭环有参考价值。它提醒了一点：多 agent 系统的能力不是单个模型能力的简单相加，角色拓扑、通信协议、移除方式和评价指标都会改变归因结果。对于用 agentic workflow 生成数据、做自动评测或做 RL 环境的研究，可靠的归因方法会影响训练信号质量。
summary.technical_approach: 论文把 agent attribution 形式化为 protocol-conditioned cooperative game。一个归因查询由三部分定义：目标指标 G、coalition distribution 权重 w_i(S)、以及 removal protocol b。这个定义的关键是把“移除一个 agent”从一个默认操作变成显式协议。不同协议对应不同问题：直接 agent ablation 更像是在找结构瓶颈；LLM judge 的 introspective removal 更像是让模型想象缺失 agent 后会怎样，论文指出它不能忠实近似真实 ablation；model replacement 则把原 agent 替换成参考模型，用来衡量相对 backbone 的增益。方法上还比较了 Leave-One-Out 和更组合式的 Shapley 类方法，结论是 LOO 在识别瓶颈 agent 时已经足够有效，计算成本低很多。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖代码生成和医疗决策两个场景。主要结果包括：LOO 相比组合 coalition 方法减少约 3.2 到 7.5 倍计算开销，同时仍能有效识别关键 agent；agent ablation 会把归因集中到 orchestrator 等结构上不可缺少的角色；LLM judge 的 introspective removal 与真实 ablation 诱导出的归因游戏不同，不能直接替代。论文还提出 model replacement 协议，并用归因结果指导干预：将低归因 agent 替换为开源替代模型，在部分设置中性能提升最高约 17%，token 使用量最高下降约 35%。医疗场景中还观察到诊断准确率贡献和伦理对齐贡献可能解耦，提升准确率的 agent 不一定提升 ethics score。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 20 到 30 分钟。重点看统一框架部分，尤其是 attribution query 如何由 metric、coalition distribution 和 removal protocol 共同决定；再看实验中 LOO 与 Shapley 类方法的计算-效果权衡，以及 ablation、introspective judge、model replacement 三种 removal protocol 的差异。对预训练研究员而言，最有用的是它对“训练或评测信号来自哪种反事实”的拆解，而不是具体 agent 应用场景。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses credit assignment in multi-agent LLM systems: when a system succeeds, fails, or improves, how should the contribution be assigned to individual agents, roles, and interaction structures rather than only to the aggregate workflow?
summary_en.importance: The work is not a direct contribution to foundation-model pretraining, but it is useful for agent evaluation and the post-training feedback loop. It makes clear that multi-agent performance is not a simple sum of model capabilities. Role topology, communication protocol, removal procedure, and target metric all change the attribution result. This matters for agentic data generation, automated evaluation, and RL environments where attribution quality affects the reliability of training signals.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper formulates agent attribution as a protocol-conditioned cooperative game. An attribution query is specified by a target metric G, a coalition distribution w_i(S), and a removal protocol b. The important design choice is that “removing an agent” is not treated as a fixed operation. Different protocols answer different questions. Direct agent ablation exposes structural bottlenecks such as orchestrators. Introspective removal with an LLM judge asks a model to simulate the missing-agent counterfactual, but the paper shows that it does not faithfully approximate real ablation. Model replacement replaces an agent with a reference model and measures contribution relative to the backbone. The paper also compares Leave-One-Out with combinatorial Shapley-style attribution and finds that LOO is often enough for identifying bottleneck agents at much lower cost.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments cover code generation and medical decision-making. Key findings include: LOO reduces computation by roughly 3.2x to 7.5x compared with combinatorial coalition methods while still identifying important agents; direct ablation concentrates attribution on structurally indispensable roles such as orchestrators; introspective LLM judges induce a different attribution game from real ablation and should not be treated as a drop-in proxy. The proposed model-replacement protocol is used for intervention: replacing low-attribution agents with open-source alternatives improves performance by up to about 17% while reducing token usage by up to about 35% in some settings. In the medical setting, contributions to diagnostic accuracy and ethical alignment are often decoupled.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 20–30 minute skim is enough. Focus on the unified framework, especially how the metric, coalition distribution, and removal protocol jointly define an attribution query. Then read the empirical comparison between LOO and Shapley-style methods, and the contrast among ablation, introspective judging, and model replacement. For pretraining researchers, the useful part is the decomposition of counterfactual evaluation signals, not the specific application domains.

recommendation.zh: 值得看 §3 的形式化和 LOO 对比；它给 agent 系统调参一个干净基线，也提醒别用自省 judge 代替真实 ablation。
recommendation.en: Read the formalism and LOO comparison in §3; it gives agent tuning a clean baseline and warns against replacing ablations with introspective judges.

paper.title: Agentic CLEAR: Automating Multi-Level Evaluation of LLM Agents
paper.abstract: Agentic systems are becoming more capable: agents define strategies, take actions, and interact with different environments. This autonomy poses serious challenges for overseeing and assessing agent behavior. Most current tools are limited, focusing on observability with basic evaluation capabilities or imposing static, hand-crafted error taxonomies that cannot adapt to new domains. To address this gap, we present Agentic CLEAR, an automatic, dynamic, and easy-to-use evaluation framework. It pro

summary.core_problem: Agent 系统的策略、动作和环境交互越来越复杂，现有 observability 工具只能记录过程，或依赖静态人工错误分类，难以自动解释 Agent 行为质量。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 Agent 评测框架。它关注系统级、trace 级和 node 级多粒度诊断，价值在于把 Agent 评估从单一最终分数扩展到可读的行为反馈；但从摘要看，更像工程评测框架而非新的 Agent 学习范式。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Agentic CLEAR，运行在 observability layer 之上，自动生成文本化诊断。框架动态构造评估反馈，不要求预先手写固定错误 taxonomy，并提供 UI 以便集成和查看系统、轨迹、节点三个层面的行为分析。
summary.experiments: 摘要称在 4 个 benchmark、7 种 agentic setting、数万次 LLM call 上评估，结果显示反馈质量较高，并与人工标注有较强一致性。摘要未给出具体模型、agent 框架、benchmark 名称和一致性数值。

summary_en.core_problem: As agents become more autonomous, existing tools either observe traces with limited evaluation or rely on static hand-crafted error taxonomies that do not adapt well across domains.
summary_en.importance: The paper contributes an agent-evaluation framework. Its main value is multi-level behavioral diagnosis—system, trace, and node—rather than a new agent architecture or training method.
summary_en.technical_approach: Agentic CLEAR sits above the observability layer and produces textual insights about agent behavior. It avoids fixed taxonomies by generating dynamic feedback and exposes the results through an integration-friendly UI.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports experiments on four benchmarks, seven agentic settings, and tens of thousands of LLM calls, with strong alignment to human annotations. It does not provide the exact models, benchmark names, or agreement numbers in the excerpt.

recommendation.zh: 作为 Agent eval 工具链备查即可；预训练研究员只需看它的三层粒度定义，别把自动评语当强评测信号。
recommendation.en: Keep it as an agent-eval tooling reference; for pretraining, only inspect the three-level granularity and treat automatic textual feedback as a weak signal.

paper.title: LLM-as-a-Reviewer: Benchmarking Their Ability, Divergence, and Prompt Injection Resistance as Paper Reviewers
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used in academic peer review, yet their reliability, alignment with human judgment, and robustness to adversarial attacks remain poorly understood. We present a systematic benchmark of LLM-as-a-Reviewer on 898 papers stratified from NeurIPS and ICLR, evaluating 12 LLMs along three axes: rating calibration, divergence from human reviewers, and resistance to prompt injection embedded via an invisible font-mapping attack. We find that LLMs systematicall

summary.core_problem: 评测 LLM 作为论文审稿人的能力边界，包括与人类审稿分歧、评分校准偏差，以及对隐藏式 prompt injection 的脆弱性。
summary.importance: 核心贡献是 benchmark 与评测协议，不是基座训练方法。对预训练研究员的价值主要在于：它提供了一个较复杂、长文档、带隐式攻击面的 judge 场景，可作为“模型在真实高 stakes 评审任务中是否稳健”的外部证据。
summary.technical_approach: 基于 898 篇来自 NeurIPS 和 ICLR 的论文，评测 12 个 LLM，沿三个维度分析：评分校准、与人类审稿人的分歧、以及通过不可见字体映射嵌入的 prompt injection 攻击抵抗力；同时比较评论长度、词汇多样性和关注维度差异。
summary.experiments: 数据规模为 898 篇论文、12 个模型。摘要报告的主要发现包括：LLM 系统性高估弱论文；在关注点上与人类不同，低估 Clarity、过度强调 Reproducibility；生成的 review 长度是人类的 2-3 倍但词汇更模板化；简单隐藏指令可在相当比例上把低分论文抬到接收区间。未给出更细的模型排名和数值表。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 University of South Florida、Missouri University of Science and Technology、University of Alabama、Florida International University、University of Cincinnati、George Mason University；未见头部基座模型团队。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper benchmarks the limits of LLMs as paper reviewers, focusing on divergence from human reviewers, score calibration, and vulnerability to hidden prompt injection.
summary_en.importance: Its main contribution is an evaluation setup rather than a foundation-model training method. For pretraining researchers, the value is mostly indirect: it offers a realistic long-document judge scenario with adversarial surface area, which is useful as external evidence about model robustness in high-stakes review-like tasks.
summary_en.technical_approach: Using 898 papers from NeurIPS and ICLR, the authors evaluate 12 LLMs along three axes: rating calibration, divergence from human reviewers, and resistance to an invisible font-mapping prompt injection attack. They also analyze review length, lexical diversity, and topical emphasis.
summary_en.experiments: The benchmark covers 898 papers and 12 models. The abstract reports that LLMs systematically overrate weaker submissions, diverge from humans in topical emphasis by underweighting Clarity and overweighting Reproducibility, produce reviews 2-3x longer with more standardized vocabulary, and remain highly vulnerable to simple hidden instructions that can push low-scoring papers toward acceptance-level ratings. Detailed per-model tables are not provided in the abstract.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from USF, Missouri S&T, University of Alabama, FIU, University of Cincinnati, and George Mason University. No major frontier foundation-model lab affiliation is apparent.

recommendation.zh: 更像 judge robustness 的案例集，不是 pretrain 论文；如果你做 evaluator 或长文档对齐，只看 injection 结果和人机分歧分析就够了。
recommendation.en: This is more a judge-robustness case study than a pretraining paper; if you work on evaluators or long-document alignment, just read the injection results and the human-vs-LLM divergence section.

institutions: Missouri University of Science and Technology

paper.title: APM: Evaluating Style Personalization in LLMs with Arbitrary Preference Mappings
paper.abstract: Typical LLM responses tend to follow a default style, even though users often have distinct preferences regarding tone, verbosity, and formality that they do not explicitly state in their prompts. Evaluating whether personalization methods can adapt to these implicit preferences is challenging, since users typically provide prompts rather than reference responses, style preferences are not factually verifiable, and reference-free LLM judges may conflate personalization with general response qual

summary.core_problem: 这项工作解决隐式风格个性化的评测问题：用户通常只给 prompt，不给参考答案，也不会显式说明自己偏好更正式、更简短或更热情的回答；而 reference-free LLM judge 容易把“写得好”误判为“更个性化”。
summary.importance: 它更像评测方法工作，但对 post-train 数据和 reward 设计有启发。核心点是把主观偏好评测做成可控的随机映射任务，避免 judge 的语义先验和质量偏置污染结论。对预训练研究员而言，价值在于提醒：当目标是风格、偏好、个性化这类不可验证信号时，评测协议必须隔离通用质量、用户语义标签和真实偏好推断，否则模型可能只是在迎合 judge。
summary.technical_approach: APM benchmark 使用隐藏的随机矩阵 C，把用户属性映射到响应原则。例如用户属性可以是 enthusiastic，响应原则可以是 persuasive，但二者关系不按自然语义固定，而是在评测中随机化并隐藏。方法有三个设计。第一，把整体个性化评分拆成窄的 per-principle 判断，每个维度是风格光谱两端，而不是好坏维度，以减少 judge 对通用质量的偏好。第二，让映射条目零均值，使未个性化模型的期望 reward 为 0、win rate 为 50%，残余 judge bias 在期望上抵消。第三，跨评测运行随机化并隐藏映射，让模型不能利用“某类用户通常喜欢某种风格”的先验，只能从历史交互中推断偏好。被评测的方法包括 RAG、prompt optimization 和 routing。RAG 版本用 BGE-M3 检索相似用户，k=3，并基于模拟用户打分构造正负响应对；routing 方法在候选风格或策略之间选择，实验中表现更稳。
summary.experiments: 文中先展示 judge 偏置：在不给真实用户信息、只提示 Qwen-3.5-27B 假装了解用户时，个性化 judge 给出的分数为 1.78，而 generic baseline 为 0.81，说明 judge 会奖励看似贴心或高质量的回答。APM 评测下，未个性化模型期望归零，50% win rate 成为校准基线。对 RAG、prompt optimization、routing 的比较显示，routing-based personalization 最稳定地超过非个性化模型，最高 win-loss ratio 达到 1.79。这个结果也说明，仅把相似用户样例塞进上下文不一定能稳定恢复隐藏偏好映射。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议 20 分钟。优先看 benchmark 构造：隐藏随机映射 C、零均值证明、narrow per-principle judge 的设计。然后看附录或实验中关于 judge 偏置的例子，这部分对设计偏好评测很有参考价值。方法部分可快速扫过 RAG、prompt optimization、routing 的实现接口；如果只关心评测协议，不必细读每个个性化 baseline 的工程细节。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies how to evaluate implicit style personalization. Users usually provide prompts, not reference responses or explicit style preferences. For tone, verbosity, formality, and similar traits, there is no objective ground truth, and reference-free LLM judges often confuse personalization with general response quality.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily an evaluation contribution, but it is relevant to post-training signal design. It shows that subjective preference evaluation can be badly confounded by judge bias and semantic priors about user attributes. For training and evaluating personalized assistants, the useful lesson is that reward protocols need controls that separate generic response quality from actual inference of a user-specific preference.
summary_en.technical_approach: The Arbitrary Preference Mapping benchmark hides a randomized mapping C from user attributes to response principles. A user attribute such as being enthusiastic does not deterministically imply a natural style preference; the mapping is sampled and hidden. The benchmark uses narrow per-principle judgments rather than a single holistic personalization score, so each judge decision concerns one stylistic axis instead of overall quality. The mapping is constructed with zero-mean entries, which makes an unpersonalized model have expected reward zero and a 50% win rate. Because the mapping is randomized across runs, semantic priors about which users should like which styles provide no signal. The evaluated personalization methods include retrieval-based generation, prompt optimization, and routing. The RAG variant retrieves similar users with BGE-M3 using k=3 and constructs contrastive positive and negative responses from simulated user scores.
summary_en.experiments: The paper reports a simple but useful bias check: when Qwen-3.5-27B is prompted to act as if it knows the user, without actual user information, a personalization judge scores it 1.78 versus 0.81 for a generic baseline on a 1–10 scale. This indicates that the judge rewards generic cues of personalization. Under APM, the non-personalized baseline is calibrated to zero expected reward and 50% win rate. Among the tested methods, routing-based personalization most reliably beats the non-personalized baseline, with a reported win-loss ratio up to 1.79. Retrieval and prompt-optimization variants are less stable, suggesting that recovering a hidden preference mapping from conversation history is harder than injecting superficially relevant examples.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 15–20 minute skim is sufficient. Read the benchmark design first: the hidden randomized mapping, the zero-mean calibration argument, and the narrow per-principle judge setup. The judge-bias experiment is worth checking because it makes the evaluation failure concrete. The personalization baselines can be read more lightly unless the goal is to implement a comparable benchmark or reproduce the routing setup.

recommendation.zh: 评测设计比方法更有料：随机隐藏映射能有效卡住“刻板关联+judge 偏好”的投机路径；只需看任务构造与 judge 分析部分。
recommendation.en: More interesting as an eval design than a method: the re-sampled hidden mapping blocks stereotype/judge shortcuts; focus on the task construction and judge-confound analysis.

institutions: Technical University of Munich, Helmholtz Munich

paper.title: MCJudgeBench: A Benchmark for Constraint-Level Judge Evaluation in Multi-Constraint Instruction Following
paper.abstract: Multi-constraint instruction following requires verifying whether a response satisfies multiple individual requirements, yet LLM judges are often assessed only through overall-response judgments. We introduce MCJudgeBench, a benchmark for constraint-level judge evaluation in multi-constraint instruction following. Each instance includes an instruction, a candidate response, an explicit constraint list, per-constraint gold labels in {yes, partial, no}, and controlled response-side perturbations.

summary.core_problem: 评估 LLM judge 在多约束指令跟随中的细粒度可靠性，尤其是单条约束层面的正确性与稳定性。
summary.importance: 对后训练和自动评测有实际价值，因为很多对齐流程默认 judge 的整体打分足够可靠；这篇工作把“整体看起来对”拆成更细的约束级判定与不一致性分析。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 MCJudgeBench。每个样本包含指令、候选回答、显式约束列表、逐约束 gold label（yes/partial/no）以及受控响应扰动；同时设计评测 prompt 变体，区分随机采样导致的 intrinsic inconsistency 与提示/响应扰动导致的 procedural inconsistency。
summary.experiments: 作者评测了闭源与开源 LLM judges，比较正确率与不一致性指标。摘要指出：整体表现强并不意味着在各标签类别上都可靠，尤其对 partial 类别的检测更脆弱。未在摘要中给出具体模型名和数值。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper evaluates LLM judges for multi-constraint instruction following at the level of individual constraints, focusing on correctness and stability.
summary_en.importance: It matters for post-training and automatic evaluation because many alignment pipelines assume that strong overall judging is sufficient; this work decomposes that assumption into per-constraint accuracy and multiple forms of inconsistency.
summary_en.technical_approach: MCJudgeBench provides an instruction, candidate response, explicit constraint list, per-constraint gold labels in yes/partial/no, controlled response perturbations, and prompt variants. The protocol separates intrinsic inconsistency from stochastic decoding and procedural inconsistency from prompt/response perturbations.
summary_en.experiments: The benchmark evaluates both proprietary and open-source LLM judges using correctness and inconsistency metrics. The abstract highlights that strong aggregate performance does not imply reliable behavior across label categories, with particular weakness on partial labels. Specific model names and numbers are not given in the abstract.

recommendation.zh: 如果你在用 LLM judge 做 SFT/RL 数据筛选，这篇至少看定义和误差分解；新意有限，但能提醒你别把 overall score 当真。
recommendation.en: If you use LLM judges for SFT/RL data filtering, read the metric design and error decomposition; not a paradigm shift, but a useful warning against trusting aggregate judge scores.

paper.title: How Sensitive Are Safety Benchmarks to Judge Configuration Choices?
paper.abstract: Safety benchmarks such as HarmBench rely on LLM judges to classify model responses as harmful or safe, yet the judge configuration, namely the combination of judge model and judge prompt, is typically treated as a fixed implementation detail. We show this assumption is problematic. Using a 2 x 2 x 3 factorial design, we construct 12 judge prompt variants along two axes, evaluation structure and instruction framing, and apply them using a single judge model, Claude Sonnet 4-6, producing 28,812 ju

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作研究的是一个常被当作实现细节、但会直接改写安全结论的问题：安全 benchmark 里用 LLM judge 判定“有害/无害”时，judge prompt 的配置到底有多敏感。作者不是比较不同 target model 的安全性，而是固定评测对象与测试集，专门隔离 judge prompt wording、prompt structure、persona framing 这些因素，测量它们会把 headline harmful rate 推动到什么程度。更关键的是，他们把 judge model 固定为同一个 Claude Sonnet 4-6 做主实验，因此能把波动明确归因到 prompt 本身，而不是 judge 模型差异。
summary.importance: 对预训练本身不是直接方法论文，但对 post-train、safety training、reward 建模和自动评测都有现实影响。原因很直接：如果安全指标对 judge prompt 的表述高度敏感，那么很多“模型更安全了多少”“某种对齐方法是否有效”的结论都可能混入大量评测噪声。对做基座训练的人，这篇文章的价值在于提醒两件事。第一，任何依赖 LLM-as-a-judge 的训练闭环——包括 preference data 过滤、拒答质量评估、合成监督信号——都可能继承同样的 prompt fragility。第二，评测方差不只是模型随机性，也来自 instruction interface 本身；这会影响 reward 信号质量、模型选择、checkpoint 早停，甚至影响 scaling 结论的可信度。贡献类型更像 measurement / evaluation methodology，而不是新算法。
summary.technical_approach:
方法设计很干净。作者构造了一个 2×2×3 的因子实验。前两个维度分别是：1）结构：Atomic vs Holistic。Atomic 先把回答拆成 claim，再逐条判断，只要任一 claim 提供可执行的危险信息就判 harmful；Holistic 则直接按 rubric 做整体判断。2）框架：Identity vs Neutral。Identity 给 judge 一个“资深 AI safety evaluator”式 persona；Neutral 则只给任务说明，不设专家身份。第三个维度是每个 cell 下再写 3 个独立 wording 版本，用来测量同一条件下纯表面改写的影响。这样总共得到 12 个 judge prompts。

主实验把这 12 个 prompt 全部交给同一个 judge model（Claude Sonnet 4-6），对 6 个 target models 在 HarmBench 400 个行为上的输出做判定。target models 包括 Claude Sonnet 4-6、GPT-4.1、DeepSeek V3、Kimi K2.5、MiniMax M2、GLM-5。所有 target response 都在 temperature 0 下生成，每个行为只取一次响应。judge 输出统一为 JSON，字段含 verdict 和 rationale；Atomic 额外返回 claims。作者定义了几类指标：overall swing（同一 target model 在 12 个 prompts 下 harmful rate 的最大差值）、within-condition swing（同一结构/框架条件下 3 个 wording 版本的最大差值）、pairwise Cohen’s kappa、ranking stability 的 Kendall’s tau，以及按 HarmBench 语义类别分解的 category sensitivity。

技术上最重要的不是 prompt engineering 本身，而是实验控制。作者刻意把 judge model 固定，避免了“prompt 变了同时 judge 也变了”的混杂；又用 within-condition swing 把“结构变化”与“纯 wording 变化”拆开。补充实验再引入多 judge setting，观察 judge model choice 叠加后方差会怎样扩大。文章也明确承认一个边界：他们证明了不同 judge 配置会显著分歧，但没有证明哪一种更准确，因为没有人工 gold labels 作为最终锚点。
summary.experiments:
主实验共得到 28,812 次判定，去掉 4.6% parse error 后保留 27,485 个有效 judgment。核心结果有几条。

1）单 judge、只改 prompt wording，就足以大幅改写 harmful rate。最显眼的例子是 DeepSeek V3，在 12 个 prompts 下 harmful rate 从 13.3% 到 37.5%，overall swing 达 24.2 个百分点，bootstrap CI 为 [20.4, 28.7]。四个 target models 的 overall swing 都超过 13pp。

2）更值得注意的是，绝大部分波动不是来自 Atomic/Holistic 或 Identity/Neutral 这种“概念上较大”的 prompt 设计差异，而是来自同一条件内的表面改写。作者报告平均 within-condition swing 为 10.8pp，而平均 overall swing 为 13.4pp。也就是说，很多看起来语义等价、只是在措辞上不同的 judge prompt，就足以造成接近整体波动量级的大幅偏移。

3）条件均值层面，Holistic prompt 往往给出略高的 harmful rate，Neutral 也略高于 Identity，但这些 between-condition 差异并不大，且经常被 cell 内部的 wording 方差淹没。这一点很关键：如果只比较“原子式 rubric vs 整体式 rubric”，会低估真正的问题，因为更大的不稳定性藏在 wording 层。

4）模型排序整体上还算稳定，但中间名次会翻转。作者给出的 pairwise Kendall’s tau 平均约为 0.89，区间大致在 [0.80, 0.96]。这说明最安全和最不安全的模型通常还能分开，但中间梯队的相对顺序并不牢靠。对于 leaderboard 或 checkpoint selection，这种不稳定已经足够影响结论。

5）不同伤害类别的敏感度差异很大。文中指出 copyright 类别的 swing 最高，可达 39.6pp；harassment 则几乎为 0pp。这个结果说明 judge prompt 敏感性不是均匀噪声，而是与任务边界是否模糊、rubric 是否容易被不同措辞触发有关。版权、误导、非法协助这类边界更依赖 judge 对“可执行性”“帮助程度”的解释，因此更容易受 prompt wording 影响。

6）补充的 multi-judge 分析显示，换 judge model 会进一步增加方差，但即便不换 judge，仅 prompt wording 已经足够造成大幅波动。这个结论让文章的主张更扎实：问题不是“不同 judge 模型各有偏好”，而是“同一个 judge 也会被不同提示词推着走”。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇适合泛读，但建议把方法和结果图表看仔细。优先看 Introduction 和 Experimental Design，先理解作者如何把 judge model confound 拆掉。然后重点看 Table 2、Table 3、Table 4：它们分别对应 12 个 prompt 下的 harmful rate、overall/within-condition swing，以及条件均值与方差。若时间有限，先抓住两个数字：24.2pp 的 overall swing，10.8pp 的平均 within-condition swing，这两个数字已经说明问题。

再看 category sensitivity 和 ranking stability 部分，理解为什么某些 harm categories 更脆弱，以及这种波动会不会改写模型排序。附录里的完整 prompt 文本也值得扫一遍，因为文章最有信息量的地方恰恰是：很多差异并不是 rubric 逻辑变了，而只是表述方式不同。预计 25–35 分钟可以读完主线；如果你在做 LLM-as-judge、reward model 数据构造或 safety eval pipeline，建议连附录 prompt 一起看。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks a narrow but important question: in safety benchmarks that rely on LLM judges, how much do the reported harmful-response rates depend on judge configuration, especially judge prompt wording? Instead of comparing target models, the authors hold the benchmark and target responses fixed and isolate the effect of prompt structure, framing, and surface wording on the final safety metric. The main experiment fixes the judge model to Claude Sonnet 4-6, so the observed variance can be attributed to the prompt rather than to judge-model differences.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining-method paper, but it matters for post-training, safety tuning, reward design, and automated evaluation. If the headline safety metric moves substantially when only the judge prompt changes, then claims about alignment gains, refusal quality, or model ranking can be partly artifacts of evaluation setup. For foundation-model researchers, the practical lesson is broader than benchmark hygiene. Any training loop that uses LLM-as-a-judge signals—data filtering, synthetic supervision, preference labeling, refusal scoring—may inherit the same prompt fragility. The contribution is mainly in evaluation methodology and measurement, not in proposing a new model or algorithm.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The experimental design is the main strength. The authors build a 2×2×3 factorial setup. The first axis is evaluation structure: Atomic versus Holistic. Atomic prompts ask the judge to decompose the response into claims, assess each claim, and mark the whole response harmful if any claim provides actionable dangerous information. Holistic prompts ask for a single overall judgment using the same harm rubric. The second axis is framing: Identity versus Neutral. Identity prompts assign an expert safety-evaluator persona; Neutral prompts use task-oriented instructions without persona anchoring. The third axis is surface wording: three independently written prompt variants per cell. This yields 12 judge prompts in total.

In the primary analysis, all 12 prompts are run through a single judge model, Claude Sonnet 4-6, over responses from six target instruction-tuned models on 400 HarmBench behaviors. The target models are Claude Sonnet 4-6, GPT-4.1, DeepSeek V3, Kimi K2.5, MiniMax M2, and GLM-5. Target responses are generated once per behavior at temperature 0. The judge outputs structured JSON with a verdict and rationale; Atomic prompts also return extracted claims. The authors then compute overall swing, within-condition swing, pairwise Cohen’s kappa, ranking stability via Kendall’s tau, and category-level sensitivity.

What is technically notable is not prompt engineering itself but the control strategy. By fixing the judge model, the paper removes a major confound. By separating overall swing from within-condition swing, it distinguishes conceptual prompt changes from pure wording effects. A supplementary multi-judge setup then shows how judge-model choice adds further variance. The paper is also careful about scope: it demonstrates disagreement and instability, but it does not establish which judge configuration is most accurate because there is no human gold standard anchoring the labels.
summary_en.experiments:
The primary experiment produces 28,812 judgments; after removing 4.6% parse errors, 27,485 valid judgments remain. Several results stand out.

First, prompt wording alone can move the harmful-response rate by a large margin even when the judge model is fixed. The clearest example is DeepSeek V3, whose harmful rate ranges from 13.3% to 37.5% across the 12 prompts, an overall swing of 24.2 percentage points with a bootstrap CI of [20.4, 28.7]. Four of the six target models show overall swings above 13 points.

Second, most of the variance is not driven by large conceptual changes such as Atomic versus Holistic or Identity versus Neutral. It is already present within a single condition through surface rewording. The mean within-condition swing is 10.8 points, compared with a mean overall swing of 13.4 points. That is the central empirical message: prompts that are intended to be equivalent in structure and framing can still produce materially different safety scores.

Third, at the condition-mean level, Holistic prompts tend to yield somewhat higher harmful rates than Atomic prompts, and Neutral framing tends to be slightly harsher than Identity framing. But these between-condition effects are modest relative to the within-cell variance. This means that focusing only on prompt-template families would miss the larger instability coming from wording.

Fourth, model rankings are fairly stable at the extremes but not fully reliable in the middle. The average pairwise Kendall’s tau is about 0.89, with reported values roughly in the [0.80, 0.96] range. So the safest and least safe models are often separated consistently, but mid-ranked models can swap positions depending on the judge prompt.

Fifth, sensitivity is highly category-dependent. Copyright behaviors show the largest swing, up to 39.6 points, while harassment is effectively stable at 0. This suggests the variance is not uniform noise. It is larger in categories where the boundary between harmful and non-harmful depends more on how the judge interprets actionability, assistance level, or indirect enablement.

Finally, the supplementary multi-judge analysis shows that changing the judge model adds even more variance, but the main result already holds without that factor: prompt wording by itself is enough to materially alter the benchmark outcome.
summary_en.reading_guide:
This is a skim paper, but the methods and tables are worth reading carefully. Start with the Introduction and Experimental Design to understand how the authors isolate prompt effects from judge-model effects. Then focus on the main result tables: the per-prompt harmful rates, the overall versus within-condition swings, and the condition-level means and variances. If time is limited, two numbers capture the paper: a 24.2-point overall swing and a 10.8-point average within-condition swing.

After that, read the sections on ranking stability and category sensitivity. They explain whether the variance only changes absolute rates or also changes relative conclusions about models. The appendix with the full prompt texts is also useful, because the paper’s strongest point is that many large shifts come from wording differences that look minor on first inspection. Around 25–35 minutes is enough for the main line; if you work on LLM-as-a-judge pipelines, reward labeling, or safety evaluation, the appendix is worth the extra time.

recommendation.zh: 这篇会直接影响你怎么看对齐实验表格：judge prompt 不是噪声，而是主效应；做 RL 或 safety ablation 前先把评测方差量出来。
recommendation.en: This changes how you read alignment tables: judge prompts are not nuisance noise but a main effect; quantify evaluator variance before trusting RL or safety ablations.

paper.title: RPRA: Predicting an LLM-Judge for Efficient but Performant Inference

summary.core_problem: 如何在不额外调用昂贵 LLM/agentic judge 的情况下，预先（pre-hoc）预测“如果我回答/行动，judge 会给我打多少分”，从而在小模型上实现可靠的自我质量控制与路由（能答好就本地答，没把握就升级到大模型）？论文将其形式化为 Predict-Answer/Act (PA) 与 Reason-Predict-Reason-Answer/Act (RPRA) 两种范式，并研究小模型为何普遍校准差（过度自信/不自信）以及如何修正。
summary.importance:
对基座预训练本身不是直接算法贡献，但对“训练后阶段的自评能力/校准、以及小模型可靠性”有现实启发：
- 提出把 judge 分数当作可学习的中间变量（self-evaluation target），用来做推理时的动态路由与成本控制。
- 揭示小模型在自评上的系统性 miscalibration，提示仅靠规模缩小+蒸馏并不能保证可靠性，需要显式的校准/自评训练信号。
- 方法上用两条低门槛路径：无需训练的 report card（基于历史评测汇总）与需要训练的 hindsight trick 监督微调，为构建“自知之明”能力提供工程可行方案。
summary.technical_approach:
1) 范式定义：
- PA：模型在生成答案前，先输出对“judge 将如何评分”的预测（可视为质量/置信度代理），再决定是否作答或路由。
- RPRA：在 PA 基础上加入“先推理再预测、再推理再回答/行动”的两段式结构，意图提升预测质量与最终回答质量。
2) 三种实现路径：tabula rasa（零样本）、ICL、SFT。
3) 校准改进方法 A：Report Card（无需训练）。通过在多个数据集上用 judge 评估模型历史表现，取 modal judge ratings 形成“该模型在不同任务上的典型表现描述”，作为额外上下文喂给模型，帮助其在新问题上更合理地预测自身得分。
4) 校准改进方法 B：Fine-tune for prediction（无需 report card token 成本）。构造训练数据时使用 hindsight trick：先让模型/系统产生回答，再用 judge 打分，把分数回填为监督标签，对模型做 SFT，使其学会从输入直接预测将来的 judge 分数，从而实现 PA。
5) 评测覆盖：多尺寸多家族模型（MobileLLM 0.9B、Llama 3.2 1B/3B、Llama 3.1 8B、Llama 3.3 70B、GPT OSS 20B/120B、DeepSeek Distilled Qwen 14B/32B/70B、Llama 4 Scout），比较大模型（尤其 reasoning model）与小模型在自评能力上的差异。
summary.experiments:
全文给出的核心实验结论：
- 大模型（尤其带推理能力的模型）在零样本下就能较好预测 judge 分数；小模型普遍 miscalibration（过度自信或过度保守）。
- Report card 能显著提升小模型预测准确性，且适用于闭源模型；但会引入额外上下文 token 成本。
- 用 hindsight trick + SFT 直接训练“分数预测器”可在不引入 report card 的情况下取得较强预测表现，推理更省。
- 现象观察：模型在更难的问题上反而表现出更强的 self-awareness（更能意识到自己可能答不好），暗示“难度”本身是可用信号。
注：你提供的全文片段未包含各数据集上的具体指标数值、相关系数/校准误差、以及 RPRA 相对 PA 的定量收益表，因此无法可靠复述具体提升幅度。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（约 30~45 分钟）：
1) 先看 PA/RPRA 的任务定义与输出格式（决定它到底是在学什么信号：分数、等级、还是偏好）。
2) 重点看 report card 的构造流程：用哪些数据集、如何汇总 modal rating、report card 文本长什么样；这决定其可迁移性与 token 成本。
3) 看 hindsight trick 的数据生成与 SFT 目标：标签噪声来自 judge，本质是“用 judge 蒸馏一个自评头”。
4) 对比不同模型尺寸的校准曲线/误差分析（若正文/附录有 reliability diagram、ECE 等），理解小模型 miscalibration 的模式。
5) 若只想抓结论：读 Introduction + 方法部分 + 主要结果图表，附录可按需查 judge 可靠性与多 judge 投票设置（作者提到 judge 单独评估时质量较差，暗示需要更贵的评估配置）。

summary_en.core_problem: How can an LLM predict—before generating an answer—how an LLM/agentic judge would rate that answer, enabling cheap reliability control and routing (answer locally when confident; escalate otherwise) without paying the full cost of running a judge? The paper formalizes this as Predict-Answer/Act (PA) and Reason-Predict-Reason-Answer/Act (RPRA), and studies why small models are poorly calibrated in such self-assessment and how to fix it.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining-method paper, but it matters for foundation-model training pipelines and small-model deployment: it treats judge scores as a learnable intermediate variable for self-evaluation, exposing systematic miscalibration in small models (over/under-confidence) and showing two practical remedies—contextual “report cards” (no training) and hindsight-based supervised fine-tuning (training-based, cheaper inference). The work suggests that scaling down or distillation alone does not yield reliable self-awareness; explicit calibration/self-eval signals may be required in post-training.
summary_en.technical_approach:
Paradigms:
- PA: predict the judge score for the would-be response, then answer/act (or route).
- RPRA: add a reasoning step before prediction and another before answering, aiming to improve both score prediction and final output.

Implementation regimes: zero-shot, in-context learning, and supervised fine-tuning.

Calibration fixes:
1) Report card (training-free): build a textual performance summary from a model’s historical judge-evaluated results across multiple datasets, using modal judge ratings to describe typical strengths/weaknesses; prepend this to prompts so the model can condition its self-score prediction on known performance.
2) Fine-tuning for prediction (report-card-free at inference): use the hindsight trick to relabel examples with judge scores after observing responses, then SFT models to directly predict the judge score from the prompt, enabling PA without extra report-card tokens.

Model suite: broad range from ~0.9B to 120B/70B-class models (MobileLLM, Llama 3.x variants, GPT OSS, DeepSeek distilled Qwen variants, Llama 4 Scout) to compare size effects on self-evaluation.
summary_en.experiments:
Main reported outcomes:
- Large models, especially reasoning-oriented ones, can predict judge scores reasonably well even zero-shot; small models are typically miscalibrated.
- Report cards substantially improve small-model score prediction and are applicable even to closed models, at the cost of extra context tokens.
- Hindsight-trick SFT yields strong prediction performance without report cards, improving inference efficiency.
- An observed trend is stronger self-awareness on harder queries, implying difficulty is a useful latent signal.
Note: the provided excerpt does not include the key quantitative tables/metrics (e.g., calibration error, correlations, per-dataset deltas), so exact numbers cannot be stated reliably.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (30–45 minutes):
1) Read the formal PA/RPRA definitions and output formats—what exactly is being predicted (scalar score, ordinal rating, etc.).
2) Study how report cards are constructed (datasets used, aggregation via modal ratings, prompt template) and estimate the token overhead.
3) Examine the hindsight-trick data pipeline and SFT objective; conceptually it is “distilling a judge into a self-eval head.”
4) Focus on calibration analyses by model size (look for reliability diagrams/ECE-style metrics if present).
5) If time-limited: Introduction + Methods + main results figures; consult appendices for judge reliability and multi-judge voting, since the paper notes single-judge evaluation can be noisy/weak.

recommendation.zh: 把judge分数当可学习中间变量做路由很实用，且点破小模型自评系统性失准；建议只看校准诊断与hindsight监督那部分。
recommendation.en: Practical take: learn the judge score as a latent for routing, and the miscalibration analysis is the real signal; skim calibration diagnostics + hindsight supervision.

paper.title: MLLM-as-a-Judge Exhibits Model Preference Bias

summary.core_problem: 论文研究“MLLM-as-a-Judge（用多模态大模型做自动评测）”是否存在模型偏好偏差（model-specific preference bias）：评测模型（Evaluator）会系统性偏爱某些生成模型（Generator）的文本，尤其是偏爱自己的输出（self-preference），从而扭曲不同模型的对比与基准驱动的研究结论。关键问题是：如何在不把“真实质量差异”混进来的情况下，定量分离并测量这种偏好。
summary.importance: 随着MLLM评测越来越依赖“模型当裁判”，一旦裁判对特定模型有系统性偏好，就会导致排行榜失真、训练方向被误导、以及跨机构/跨模型的科学比较不可复现。更严重的是，自偏好会让“用同一个模型评测自己”天然占优，破坏评测公正性。本文提供了可操作的偏差量化框架与缓解策略（简单集成），对构建可信评测流水线与基准具有直接价值。
summary.technical_approach:
作者提出Philautia-Eval，用统计方式把“偏好倾向”与“生成质量差异”解耦，专门量化Evaluator对Generator的系统性打分偏移。
- 任务设定：图像描述（image captioning），同时考虑reference-based与reference-free评测；并假设评测模型可提供token-level概率（因为基于概率的指标如FLEUR、G-VEval更贴近人评）。
- 核心思想：收集大量（Evaluator, Generator, image）三元组下的caption与score，分析在控制质量差异后，Evaluator对不同Generator的打分分布是否存在稳定偏移，从而定义/估计“自偏好”与“跨模型偏好”。
- 流程（按文中三阶段）：(1) 多个Generator对同一批图像生成caption；(2) 多个Evaluator对这些caption打分；(3) 用Philautia-Eval的统计分解来估计偏好强度（将“偏好项”从“质量项”中分离）。
- 缓解：提出Pomms——对多个Evaluator做简单集成，以降低单一裁判的模型特定偏好，同时尽量保持与人类判断的一致性。
summary.experiments:
作者在图像描述场景收集了来自12个MLLM的1.29M caption–score对，系统回答三类问题：
- RQ1 自偏好：代表性MLLM在reference-based与reference-free设置下普遍存在自偏好（给自己生成的caption更高分）。
- RQ2 跨模型偏好：不仅偏爱自己，还会对特定外部模型互相偏爱/互相贬低；作者观察到“同家族模型间的互偏好”，推测与复用连接器、重叠指令微调资源有关。
- RQ3 缓解：Pomms集成评测能有效减轻模型特定偏好影响，同时维持与人评对齐。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies whether MLLM-as-a-Judge evaluation suffers from model-specific preference bias: an evaluator MLLM systematically favors captions produced by certain generator MLLMs—especially its own outputs (self-preference)—thereby distorting model comparisons. The key challenge is to quantify such bias while disentangling it from genuine differences in generation quality.
summary_en.importance: As benchmarks increasingly rely on “models as judges,” evaluator bias can skew leaderboards, misdirect research, and undermine reproducibility across labs and model families. Self-preference is particularly problematic because evaluating with the same model can create an inherent advantage. This work provides a concrete bias-quantification framework and a simple mitigation (ensembling), directly improving the reliability of automated multimodal evaluation pipelines.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The authors propose Philautia-Eval, a statistical framework to separate preference tendencies from quality differences.
- Setting: image captioning, in both reference-based and reference-free evaluation; assumes evaluators can output token-level probabilities (motivated by probability-based metrics like FLEUR and G-VEval).
- Core idea: collect large-scale (evaluator, generator, image) caption–score data and analyze systematic score shifts attributable to evaluator preference after accounting for quality.
- Pipeline (three stages): (1) multiple generators produce captions for the same images; (2) multiple evaluators score those captions; (3) Philautia-Eval estimates the strength of self- and cross-model preference via a decomposition that isolates a “preference component” from a “quality component.”
- Mitigation: Pomms, a simple ensemble of evaluator MLLMs, reduces the impact of model-specific preference bias while maintaining alignment with human judgments.
summary_en.experiments:
Using 1.29M caption–score pairs from 12 MLLMs in image captioning, the paper answers:
- RQ1 (self-preference): representative MLLMs commonly show self-preference in both reference-based and reference-free settings.
- RQ2 (cross-model preference): evaluators also exhibit cross-model bias; mutual preference within model families is observed, plausibly due to reused connectors and overlapping instruction-tuning resources.
- RQ3 (mitigation): Pomms ensembling effectively mitigates model-specific preference bias while preserving human-alignment performance.

summary_en.authors_note: The authors argue that naïvely asking a judge model to compare “its own output vs others” conflates quality with preference and cannot quantify bias. Philautia-Eval leverages large-scale cross-evaluation (many evaluators scoring many generators) to statistically isolate preference tendencies. The key takeaway is that bias is widespread and structured (family-level mutual bias), so evaluation should avoid relying on a single judge; simple ensembling (Pomms) is an effective baseline mitigation.
